amendment_note: Prospective hard-domain stress test on one H100. Frozen after source-only materialization of three untouched corpora and before any v2.2 profile or learning curve.

intervention.transform: split each fixed byte stream into s equal contiguous lanes and emit the transpose round-robin
invariants: fixed larger learner and token budget within every cell

spectrum.position_sampling: uniform corpus-wide time indices with every interleaved lane represented in both cross-fit folds

difficulty.primary: dataset-stride median final held-out CE divided by initial held-out CE; higher is harder
difficulty.secondary: dataset-stride median normalized held-out curve area over log1p token time

confirmatory_test.statistic: mean of three within-dataset Spearman correlations between locality and primary difficulty
confirmatory_test.null: independently permute the four difficulty labels within every dataset
confirmatory_test.support_rule: SUPPORTED if mean rho>=0.80, exact p<0.05, stride-16 difficulty exceeds stride-1 in all 3 datasets, and every seed-specific blocked mean rho is positive
confirmatory_test.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE unless mean rho<=0 or fewer than 2 endpoint directions, which is REFUTED

cleanliness_diagnostic.comparison_only: not part of the confirmatory verdict because learner and domains differ from v2.1
cleanliness_diagnostic.cleaner_rule: all three per-domain final rhos>=0.80 and both mean final rho and mean area rho exceed the recorded v2.1 values

scope: hard-domain stress test of the causal locality effect under a moderately larger fixed Transformer; not directly pooled with v2.0/v2.1 learner results
